versions.localizedDescription:
# v0.4.0
A big update featuring a fully redesigned People and groups experience, a faster Home, smarter bank imports, and a safer sign-in and sync!

### What's New
- **Redesigned People & Groups:** A fresh People tab and group screens, now with the option to add members who aren't on Timonia yet, so you can split expenses with anyone.
- **Swipe Between Cards and Ledger:** On Home, swipe to move between your cards and the full ledger.
- **Import Review Mode:** Review freshly imported bank transactions in a dedicated mode, with a quick chip to exit when you're done.
- **Smarter Bank Movements:** Transfers now get clearer, more meaningful titles, and already imported movements are retitled automatically. Bank accounts also show the institution name on screen.

### Fixes & Improvements
- **Safer Sessions & Sync:** Local data is now tied to your account, and syncs are safely stopped across logout, so data never mixes between accounts.
- **Expired Session Sign-In:** A redesigned sign-in screen for expired sessions, shown as a centered identity card.
- **Cleaner Transaction Details:** Removed the redundant expense/income label from the details header and polished the "What is this movement?" label.
- **Clearer Edit Form:** The bank description and naming-rule notice are now grouped together in the transaction edit form.
- **Reliable Bank Errors:** Stale data is cleaned up automatically, and bank errors are now handled more consistently.
- **UI Polish:** Smoother loading dots, no more startup loading text, and the docked header no longer lets touches through to the content below.

# v0.3.1

A focused update bringing real-time awareness to your synced bank activity!

### What's New
- **Imported Bank Movement Notifications:** Get notified whenever new bank transactions are imported or synced, making it easy to stay on top of your latest movements and review them right away.

# v0.3.0
A new update featuring a redesigned transaction details experience, custom merchant naming rules, and improved auth & sync stability!

### What's New
- **Redesigned Transaction Details:** A brand new, polished details screen giving you a clearer breakdown of your expenses and updating transaction reconciliation flows.
- **Custom Brand & Merchant Rules:** Automatically remembers how you prefer to name transactions for specific brands, with a dedicated management screen to review, edit, and customize your naming rules at any time.

### Fixes & Improvements
- **Cleaner Logout Flow:** Improved sign-out handling and state cleanup to ensure a smoother, reliable transition.
- **Network & Sync Safeguards:** Prevented background sync requests when operating unauthenticated, avoiding unnecessary server calls and errors.
- **Rule Alignment:** Fixed multiple UI and architectural rule violations across components and screens for a more cohesive experience.

# v0.2.0

A new update with guest mode, better session handling, and a few quality-of-life improvements!

### What's New
- **Guest Mode:** You can now use Timonia without creating an account. Your data stays on your device, and you can sign up or log in later without losing it. When logging into an existing account, you can choose to merge or discard your local data.
- **Better Session Handling:** If your session expires or the server logs you out, you can keep using the app with your local data and log in again whenever you're ready.
- **Redesigned Sign-Out:** Updated sign-out confirmation with data sync before logging out.

### Fixes
- Buttons now adapt to the selected language.
v0.1.2 — Redesigned modal navigation with iOS edge swipe back, refreshed offline badge, centered color picker, simplified profile avatars, and an updated email verification screen.
v0.1.1 — Introduced a new app logo, visual animations, starting balance editing support, and various bug fixes.
